quest.title: Wangshu Take-Away
quest.description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd love to, but I have to get going.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Well, have it then. I'll figure something out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll take care of it right now.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: You have my thanks. But you know Almond Tofu. <color=#00E1FFFF>You shake it around a bit, and it falls apart</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: So be careful, now. <color=#00E1FFFF>Don't just run, climb or fly around any old how you like</color>.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Laid Back Ling'guan

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: My food should be showing up any minute now...

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Hehe, thanks. I'm surprised that Wangshu Inn delivers this far out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: That's right. Ling'guan asked for some Almond Tofu before heading off to Mingyun Village again.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: It's an odd place, Mingyun Village is.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: In any case, I hope to get someone who can help me deliver it to her.
